name: Rakuen Meikyuu PET
source:
Year 2007. Main character gets a media CD after he spends a night with her. She promises him some work, but instead he gets hunted by various people and organizations willing to take possession of that CD.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2007年。主人公与她共度一夜后得到了一张媒体光盘。她承诺给他一份工作，结果他却被各种企图夺取那张光盘的人和组织追杀。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
